thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: Streaming error surge for CedarPointHealth (vpc-eu-west). Metric: gateway.stream_error_rate > 7% sustained over 7m. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:
Sofia Eng: Im taking this. seeing a lot of `NET_ERR` / `WS_CONN_RESET` from appgw pods eu-west-3. Patterns show many short-lived connections from the customer's app cluster.
Raj Platform: Confirmed. Looks like client retries are aggressive and piling up. Their streaming connections are filling accept queues -> backlog -> worker overwhelm.
Sofia Eng: Any deploys on our side?
CedarPoint Ops: CedarPoint just rolled a client release last night that tightened their retry backoff and lowered socket timeout to 5s. Theyre reporting large number of reconnects.
Hazel AE: Customer impact: real-time vitals dashboard delayed, a couple of clinicians reported missed updates. This customer is on a dedicated-vpc (dedicated-cp-1) with strict isolation.
Sofia Eng: Immediate actions: 1) Apply per-tenant connection cap and burst queueing 2) Enable tenant-scoped circuit breaker to return 429 with Retry-After 3) Drain long-lived ingest to a spare non-streaming pool.
Raj Platform: Running per-tenant conn cap now:
```
redwoodctl tenants update --id cedarpoint --conn-limit 80
```
Pushed to eu-west-3.
Raj Platform: Also deploying temp circuit breaker policy on /ws/stream:
```
redwoodctl policy apply --tenant cedarpoint --route "/ws/stream" --cb 15s --threshold 40
```
This will give clients a clear signal instead of tight reconnect loops.
incident-bot: ACTION: conn-limit & policy applied at 3420009400.
Mei CS: Notifying customer channels: told them weve applied network-side protection and asked them to roll their client patch to respect Retry-After and exponential jitter. Theyve started a phased rollout. ETA ~20-40m.
Sofia Eng: Im increasing websocket keepalive from 30->60s and enabling accept-queue backpressure logging for tenant slice.
```
kubectl -n appgw patch deployment appgw-eu --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/WS_KEEPALIVE","value":"60"}]'
```
Raj Platform: While throttling, I routed high-throughput ingest endpoints to fallback pool `dedicated-cp-ingest` to relieve stream pool:
```
redwoodctl routing add --tenant cedarpoint --match-path /api/ingest --pool dedicated-cp-ingest --mode immediate
```
This should lower stream worker pressure.
CedarPoint Ops: We can confirm a drop in immediate errors after you applied the cap, still seeing a minority of sessions failing. Were accelerating client patch.
Sofia Eng: Observability: enabled tenant tag `cedarpoint-stream-trace` and bumped sampling to 60% to get better traces on reconnect behavior.
Hazel AE: Noting business impact and informing account team. Will prepare statement for clinical ops to explain temporary degraded real-time fidelity.
Oncall-EU: Taking over live watch. Current metrics: stream_error_rate down from 8.1% -> 2.7% in 5m, p95 latency improving. Circuit breaker returning 429s as expected. Will escalate if rate creeps above 5%.
Mei CS: Customer comms: requesting that CedarPoint implement client-side backoff config: min 500ms, max 3s, jitter, and honor 429 Retry-After. Well follow up with SDK guidance.
Sofia Eng: Post-incident items: 1) Add per-tenant circuit-breaker runbook + templated redwoodctl commands 2) Add SDK docs for handling 429 and retry-after 3) Run replay test in staging simulating their retry pattern 4) Investigate whether accept-queue tuning can be more forgiving for dedicated pools.
CedarPoint Ops: Appreciate the fast mitigation. Were rolling the client change now and will report progress in ~30m.
Oncall-EU: Logging handoff into incident tracker and creating a postmortem ticket. Ill include metrics, client rollout timeline, and mitigation commands. Monitoring until 3420012500 then nightly watch handoff. :white_check_mark:
